text_block_list.text:
One day, an invitation to a fan event 
scheduled for Halloween arrived on my PC.
choice_data_list:
You're not going to join, right? Things 
like this, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I care not. Clear my schedule. I shall 
bestow my grace upon the people with my 
own hands."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, you're from the same hometown as 
me!? You sure came a long way. Thanks a 
bunch!"

text_block_list.name: Lara's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I wanted to see Lala-san, no matter 
what...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm real happy to hear that. ...I'll slip 
ya some candy later as a bonus. Keep it a 
secret from everyone else, alright?

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan
text_block_list.text:
So, lately my little brother and I—wait, 
ah!? I'm sorry, Buena-san! I've been doing 
all the talking!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Please don't worry about it. In 
fact, it makes me happy, you know?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Just as everyone wants to get to know me 
—I want to get to know all of you, too!

The day of the fan event. While the 
Umamusume participating alongside her 
interacted brilliantly with the crowd, as 
for her—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—You hold your head too high. Bow low and 
accept this with reverence.
choice_data_list: (......That might be a bit too salty...!)

text_block_list.text:
So I hurriedly went to ask girls who were 
good at fan service to support her, but—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Nah? I don't really think it's necessary, 
though? Given that it's Orfevre-san... 
right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they have a kind heart deep down! 
There's really no need to worry, I'm sure 
it'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list:
What's wrong? Is there something over 
there?

What's wrong? Is there something over 
there?

text_block_list.text:
Drawn by her gaze, I looked where she was 
looking. There, a nervous-looking boy and 
his mother were talking quietly while 
glancing our way.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you there. By royal decreeâcome 
here.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Speak your desire. The King shall grant 
you a boon.

text_block_list.name: Boy Fan
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Um, well... I-I'm... *sob*...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ......Very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
This too is the duty of a king. I shall 
grant you a moment's wait.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Never forget, however, that you are 
usurping my valuable time.

text_block_list.name: Boy Fan
text_block_list.text:
......! E-Excuse me... um! Orfevre-san! 
I...!!

text_block_list.name: Boy Fan
text_block_list.text:
I want to... take photos...!! Together 
with you!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You could have just said so sooner.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...See? Just like I said, right?

On the way home after wrapping up the fan 
event. Before I knew it, my thoughts 
spilled out aloud.
choice_data_list:
You're really gentle with children, aren't 
you?

You're really gentle with children, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hah. What of it? A King should be 
universally benevolent, should they not?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Still, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
They are pure. Innocent, a snow-white 
unblemished by defilement—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I prefer purity.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Its value is equal to that of a 
precious gem. You, too, must welcome it 
with the utmost hospitality."

A smile naturally formed on my face. My 
heart felt warm with the joy of getting to 
know another side of her.
